The exact rational cubic example and 3970 finite checks corroborate the algebra, not the infinite conclusions.

value.rationale: The 2026 superquadratic-Adam literature motivates understanding spike/cycle behavior beyond quadratic local stability. On a natural strictly convex power objective, this result gives a sharp every-initialization convergence cutoff and a saddle-node creation of attracting and repelling nonzero cycles without loss of minimizer stability. Such bistability is a structural obstruction to interpreting deterministic normalized training convergence solely by local Hessian stability; it supplies explicit step/epsilon scaling, orbit multipliers and exact algebraic convergence rate. These claims do not arise as textbook deductions for the already-published quadratic normalized map and do not extend to positive moment memories.
